# Test fixtures

Everything here is **synthetic** (written for this project) unless a row says otherwise. Never
add real meeting audio, transcripts, vault content or personal data. Audio fixtures follow
SPECIFICATION §15.5 Q4: clips of at most 60 s and 2 MB named `*.fixture.<ext>`, with source,
licence and speaker consent recorded below.

## `notes/` (Phase 03)
| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-10-11 - Product Sync.md` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/test_golden.py` | Golden note: frontmatter, Appendix B header, four sections, AI Recommendations last |
| `2026-10-11 - Product Sync.transcript.md` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/test_golden.py` | Golden companion transcript paired with the note (merged turns, an unmapped speaker, data block) |
| `user-edited.md` | Synthetic, hand-written | A note edited the way a user would in Obsidian: block-style lists, a frontmatter comment, a user property, a callout, text between sections, an edited heading, trailing text |
| `damaged-markers.md` | Synthetic, hand-written | A section whose closing marker was deleted (R11 error path) next to an intact section |

The names and people are invented. Regenerate the golden pair with
`MM3_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/test_golden.py` and review the diff; the format
itself is defined in `docs/dev-guide/note-format.md`.
